load_image_as_tensor: load an image from a file path and return it as a normalized PyTorch tensor
store_depth_map: store a depth map as a compressed 16-bit EXR file using OpenCV
load_labeled_mesh: load a labeled PLY mesh with vertex positions, colors, semantic class IDs, and instance IDs
store_labeled_image: store per-pixel label IDs as a color-mapped RGB PNG with id_to_color_mapping metadata
get_method_by_extension: get the appropriate load or store callable for a file based on its extension
